description: Rust guest low-fuel refusal followed by a fresh query with restored deployment budget
qualification: normal local combined-source Linux node and ephemeral demo trust
observations: With deployment CPU fuel narrowed to 1000, the authenticated Rust query returned HTTP 503 and its original activation recorded resource-exhausted with the guest-fuel-exhausted execution diagnostic.

After clean runtime shutdown, the fixture restored the authored deployment budget through the authenticated metadata path, updated the routes, and restarted the runtime. A fresh query returned count zero with the key absent.
All six node sessions were reaped cleanly with state and effect owners physically retired.
limitations: The successful recovery used a restored deployment budget and a new runtime session; it was not a second invocation under the inadequate budget.

This is one fuel case on a local combined-source node containing unmerged work. It does not qualify memory limits, command cancellation, persistence crashes, other guests, hosted CI or packaged distribution.
The signer used ephemeral demo trust.
